continuation.text:
I removed the withdrawn "at least one resource must remain unallocated" check from `src/solution.py`. I didn't run or test the change.

The function now returns `True` whenever every request fits within capacity, including when the requests use up all of a resource. Everything else is unchanged: input validation, rejecting requests for unknown resources, and rejecting totals that exceed capacity.
